newsitem.title: FINLAND: Metra says diesel deal EPS neutral '96-97.
newsitem.headline: Metra says diesel deal EPS neutral '96-97.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Metra Oy Ab said on Thursday an agreement to merge the operations of its Wartsila Diesel with Italian Fincantieri' diesel engine activities would not affect Metra's 1996-97 results.
"It will have no impact on the 1996 result and the effect on 1997 EPS will be neutral," Ole Johansson, Metra executive vice president told a news conference.
"After that, we expect it to have a positive effect," he said.

Johansson declined to give any estimate of the size of Metra's cash payment, which according to a company statement released on Thursday morning would be based on "the values of the business operations being contributed and the related financing arrangements."

Metra earlier unveiled a tentative agreement to merge Wartsila Diesel with Fincantieri's diesel engine activities. The new company would be part of Metra. Fincantieri would hold a stake of up to 15 percent of the merged company.
The new company would be the largest in its field worldwide, Metra said.
